children: HONG KONG, Sept. 23, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- D2 Intelligence, a subsidiary of Wenge AI (1956.HK), has launched DocuMind, an enterprise document intelligence and decision platform. Designed for financial services, insurance and public services — where accuracy, compliance and traceability are critical — DocuMind brings document recognition, information extraction, cross-document verification and risk review into a single workflow. The platform enables institutions to make verifiable and auditable business decisions supported by a comprehensive evidence trail.

Enterprises handle large volumes of unstructured documents, including bills of lading, invoices, contracts and identity documents. Critical information is often scattered across formats, languages and business systems. Traditional OCR extracts text but misses relationships and business logic. Conventional compliance systems rely on manually coded rules, costly to maintain, while LLMs may produce inconsistent outputs with unclear sources. Consistent, audit‑ready document review remains a key barrier to enterprise AI adoption.

Built on Wenge AI's DOMA architecture — Data, Ontology, Models and Agents — DocuMind integrates data governance, ontology modelling, model adaptation and agent orchestration. The platform uses OCR and vision‑language models to convert multilingual, multimodal documents into structured data. It applies domain ontologies, knowledge graphs and business rules to interpret entity relationships, constraints and transaction logic across documents. LLMs and multi‑agent systems use knowledge bases and external data to assess document completeness, credibility, transaction logic and related risks.

Every DocuMind conclusion is traceable for compliance and accuracy. Extracted fields link to their source locations, and each conclusion keeps its rationale, evidence and audit trail. Institutions can configure fields, rules, thresholds and workflows to fit internal policies. Low‑risk cases run automatically, medium‑risk cases go to reviewers, and high‑risk cases are escalated. A side‑by‑side interface lets reviewers compare documents with structured results, locate evidence and complete approvals efficiently.

DocuMind supports trade finance, credit documentation, KYC/KYB and compliance review. In trade finance, it extracts parties, amounts, ports, routes and goods descriptions from invoices and bills of lading. It cross‑checks data against sanctions lists, dual‑use databases and institutional rules to flag inconsistencies and compliance risks. In the HKMA GenA.I. Sandbox, the system processed a trade finance document of up to 10 pages in under 30 seconds, compared with 10–20 minutes manually. Extraction accuracy for core fields exceeded 95%, and the review automation rate reached approximately 85%. DocuMind also supports data masking, isolated environments and on‑premises deployment for institutional privacy and security.

DocuMind supports insurance underwriting and claims by classifying and linking identity documents, medical records, reports, invoices and prescriptions. It detects blurred, duplicated, recaptured or tampered images and reconstructs timelines for fragmented submissions, helping reviewers understand cases, identify anomalies and complete reviews.

DocuMind supports public‑sector application reviews, approvals, onboarding, due diligence and compliance evidence management. The platform organises fragmented documents into unified, verifiable review records, reducing duplicate entry and manual comparison and providing a clear basis for approvals, risk reviews and outcomes.

A Wenge AI spokesperson said enterprise AI must move beyond content generation. Real value comes from working within business processes using rules, traceable evidence and human oversight. DocuMind applies Wenge AI's full‑stack capabilities to deliver flexibility, controls and traceability for secure, responsible AI adoption.

D2 Intelligence is a data and decision intelligence company powered by AI LLMs. We provide products and solutions for digital transformation, cross‑modal analytics, AI‑assisted decision optimization, AIGC content creation, financial risk management and investment research. We serve global brands, financial institutions and media companies including Haier, BYD, Kantar, China Construction Bank, China Merchants Bank, Guotai Junan Securities and CMG Asia-Pacific. Our headquarters is in Hong Kong, with R&D teams across major cities in Mainland China.
